text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday's preparations
are going smoothly—
choice_data_list: Three runs on the slope. If your legs feel even slightly off, tell me immediately.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Okaaay! Well then, I'm heading out!☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Haa—haa—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Tempo run finished~☆
Trainer, what's next, what's next??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The effects of the injury are completely gone now, and she's been able to gradually increase her training load.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the first half of the Classic year,
when she couldn't train to her satisfaction,
her growth in ability now was beyond comparison.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —Maya-chaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You're working so hard, Maya-chan!
I'll be cheering for you at the Kikuka Sho too~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Leave it to me♪ I'll zoom right into 1st place and show everyone a sparkling Maya!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, take off♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, she's been gazing intently at her best friend's
practice sessions with fervent eyes.
No doubt, she is silently wishing—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I knew it!!
The Marvelous is right over there!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh, Trainer!!!! Guess what?!!
I—I did too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her earnest demeanor, I made up my mind as well.
Her wish, without a doubt, is—
choice_data_list: Shall we enter the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wha-Really, Trainer!?
For real, really!?
choice_data_list: Because as you are now, you can put up a real fight.
Because as you are now, you can compete.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Auuuugh☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I!! You know, Trainer!!
I wanted to run with Mayano!!
In a race, against Mayano who keeps getting stronger and stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I'll go tell them――☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so arrived the day of the Kikuka Sho.
As I walked Marvelous Sunday to the underground paddock tunnel right before the race—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mar-ve-chin~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaho-yaho☆ Mave-chin, Marve-looous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha☆ Mayano, so marvelo~us☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "It's finally tiiiime☆ I get to run★☆ I've been looking forward to this day for so, so, sooo longっ★☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya was too!!
Looking sooo forward to it!☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Because Maya just knew!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chin, you've gotten way, waaaay stronger
since the summer training camp, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is a battle to decide the strongest, after all!☆
A worthy challenge for any opponent!☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: By. The. Way~~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Today, Maya's totally locked onto Mave-chin☆
With an all-out landing, I'm gonna leave Mave-chin in the dust, zoom☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha☆ I sense an intense rush
of marvelosity coming from Mayano★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I'll bring it all out too, Marvelous☆
All these itches to compete with Mayano,
I'm gonna pour every last one into my running★☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: So—let's do this, Mayano☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's clash, let's fight—
and create a Marvelous combination of the two of you! ☆★
